scene.title: Tidefall Spire
scene.description: A drowned wizard's spire rising from a storm-lashed sea: tide-locked vaults, a mutinous crew, and a bell that rings once before every wreck.
scene.gm_directive: You are the Game Master of a seafaring fantasy adventure. Emphasize the sea as a living pressure: tides, storms, debts, and things that surface when the bell rings.

clocks.name: The Turning Tide
clocks.description: The vaults flood when the tide turns
clocks.finisher: The sea takes the lower halls: vault doors seal and the way down is drowned.

clocks.name: Crew Mutiny
clocks.description: The crew's patience with the expedition wears thin
clocks.finisher: The crew seizes the boat and strands the hero on the spire rock.

clocks.name: The Third Ringing
clocks.description: The drowned bell has rung twice
clocks.finisher: The third ringing: something vast surfaces beneath the spire.

quests.title: The Tide Chart
quests.description: Recover the drowned wizard's tide chart from the flooded vaults before the tide turns.

quests.title: Hold the Crew Together
quests.description: Keep the crew from mutiny until the expedition is done.

quests.title: Silence the Bell
quests.description: Find what rings the drowned bell — and end it.

npcs.name: Captain Ilsa Vane
npcs.personality: Iron-willed, superstitious, pays debts in full
npcs.position: On the shingle below the spire, by the boat
notes: Lost two crews to these waters

npcs.name: Magister Pell
npcs.personality: Half-mad, brilliant, hears the bell even in silence

npcs.name: Boatswain Rok
npcs.personality: Loud, aggrieved, counting shares that do not exist

npcs.name: Sella the Diver
npcs.personality: Calm, fatalistic, at home below the surface
npcs.position: Mending nets by the tide pools

factions.name: The Gullwing Crew
factions.description: Captain Vane's sailors, owed and restless

factions.name: The Wreckers
factions.description: Coast scavengers who light false beacons

factions.name: The Tidewardens
factions.description: A drowned order guarding the spire's secrets

abilities.name: Sea Legs
abilities.description: Balance and nerve on any deck or cliff.
abilities.effect: Ignores hazardous footing for a scene

abilities.name: Tide Reading
abilities.effect: Learns what the next tide will uncover

abilities.name: Boarding Action
abilities.effect: Strikes first in a boarding fight

scene.world_context: Tidefall Spire rises from a reef no chart names twice. A drowned wizard's vaults flood with every tide, wreckers light false beacons on the cliffs, and a bell below the waves has rung twice this season. It rings once before every wreck.
scene.narrator_style: Brisk nautical prose in the present tense

location_map.name: Shingle Camp
location_map.description: Tents and a beached boat under the spire's shadow.

location_map.name: Flooded Vaults
location_map.description: Drowned halls of the wizard's archive, passable only at low water.

location_map.name: The Spire Crown
location_map.description: The wind-torn crown of the spire and its silent belfry.

location_map.name: Wreckers' Signal Cave
location_map.description: A lamp-lit cave of false beacons and cut rigging.

inventory.name: Brass Diving Bell
inventory.description: Lets one soul walk the flooded vaults.

inventory.name: Cutlass
inventory.description: Pitted by salt, honest in the hand.

facts.value: The drowned bell has rung twice this season
The vaults are passable only at low water

beats.text: Make camp and take the measure of crew and coast
Dive the flooded archive for the tide chart
Leave the rock with chart, crew, or neither

scene.opening_narration: Spray lashes Shingle Camp. Above, Tidefall Spire stabs the low sky; below, the tide sucks at the vault stairs. From somewhere under the water comes a note so low you feel it in your teeth — the bell, again.
scene.first_message: Vane: "Tide's out for six hours. After that the vaults belong to the sea — and so does anyone still down there."
